title: finding(app-shell): Studio's app designer in design mode names a nav item whose label is a locale map "Item N" (AppNavCanvas `navLabel` reads the label only as a string), while the preview beside it shows the resolved text
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` measured. The objectui#11100 dev ran a probe at PR objectui#11127's head `cbe37f8b2` (not committed): `AppPreview` in `editing` mode, locale `zh-CN`, one nav item labelled `{ en: 'Accounts', 'zh-CN': '客户' }`. The design canvas row read `Item 1`, while the landing line above it read `客户` (PR objectui#11127's fix).

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11127 (objectui#11100), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings` (`5894787139`). That PR's contract review (`5895011457`, ③ d) confirmed it at the head: pre-existing, and the file is byte-identical at base and head. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `0ecaa7dbb`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx`:
- `navLabel(it, i)` (`:164`–`:169`) keeps a label only when `typeof l === 'string'`, and otherwise answers the positional `Item ${i + 1}`. The spec types a nav item's `label` as `I18nLabel`, a string or a per-locale map.
- **Read only, not measured:** `renameItem` (`:260`–`:264`) writes `{ ...cur, label: nextLabel }`, a plain string. Renaming a map-labelled item in the canvas would therefore replace the whole map, and every other locale's text would be lost. Triage should rule on this in the same card.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- It is the same family as objectui#11100 (a locale-map nav label read as a string), which PR objectui#11127 closed for the preview. Resolve the canvas label through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel(label, locale)` in the designer locale, as `AppPreview` now does, and keep `Item N` only for a label that is truly absent.
- For the rename path: decide whether an inline rename edits the current locale's entry of a map, or refuses and routes the author to the map editor. ⛔ It must not silently replace a map with a string.
- Pins: a map-labelled item under en and zh in design mode shows the resolved text; a plain string is the control; and the rename rule chosen for a map-labelled item.
- Serial: objectui#10862 (`pm:queue`) moves this preview family's chrome strings.

## Dedupe

The 1100 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `AppNavCanvas`: 2 hits, objectui#7469 and PR objectui#10315 (a `doc` nav type's meta), neither about labels.
- `navLabel`: 0 hits.
- `renameItem`: 0 hits.
- `Item 1`: 6 hits, none about this canvas.
- Absent control `zzqq_never_written_token_4242`: 0 hits.

No card covers this.
